name: discover
description: Return this node's full catalog of owner-approved publications: teasers grouped by topic, with ids, freshness, and price. Free. Choose zero, one, multiple, or all ids; call get once per chosen id.

name: get
description: Fetch one owner-approved publication by its id from the discover catalog. Each call buys exactly one publication. Damaged ids are rejected before payment; use a current catalog because a just-revoked id can still be billed.
